capabilities: Scan vault tasks and reminder lines into a scheduled notification queue
Deliver reminders as ntfy scheduled messages shown by the Android ntfy app
Send and receive messages across Telegram, Feishu, WeCom, Discord, Slack, Matrix, QQ Bot and email accounts
Manage pending, completed and vault-wide todos in an in-app manager panel
Forward reminder events to an optional AI webhook
disambiguation: Despite the ntfy-focused name, it is a multi-channel notification hub that also sends and receives messages through Telegram, Feishu, WeCom, Discord, Slack, Matrix, QQ Bot and email.
extras: Warns that data sent to ntfy or AI webhooks passes through the configured server and recommends private topics, tokens or self-hosting. Changelog is largely in Chinese with English summaries; the built-in manager opens as a main editor tab rather than a web page.
motivation: The author built it around ntfy because Obsidian mobile plugins cannot directly create Android system notifications, so delivery is delegated to the ntfy app.
problem: Obsidian plugins, especially on mobile, cannot post Android system notifications directly, so task reminders do not fire outside the app.

relations.evidence: It also understands Obsidian Tasks plugin Emoji Format on open task lines.
Cancip can register its own handler without Ntfy Notifications importing Cancip

requires.name: provider accounts or credentials for non-ntfy channels

summary: Notification hub that scans vault tasks and reminder lines and pushes them to ntfy, plus Telegram, Feishu, Discord, Slack, Matrix and other channels.
